description: Cash rounding to the smallest payable coin (CHF, CAD, SEK, AUD or a caller rule) — Rounds up to 100 final cash totals to the smallest payable increment, for an agent computing what a customer actually pays in cash or the change owed. Built-in rules exist only for currencies with an official source: CHF 0.05 (Münzverordnung SR 941.101), CAD 0.05 (Government of Canada), SEK 1 (Lag 1970:1029), AUD 0.05 (Consumer Protection WA); any other currency needs a caller increment. amount.description: Decimal string such as "-12.50" (up to 15 integer and 12 fraction digits). JSON numbers are not accepted: they are binary floats.

increment.description: Caller rule: smallest payable amount in major units, e.g. "0.05". Overrides the built-in rule.

rounding.description: Tie mode only: an exact tie between two payable amounts under a caller increment or a built-in rule that states no tie rule. Any other amount rounds to the nearest payable amount, and a tie rule the cited source states (SEK) wins. half-up: ties away from zero. half-down: ties toward zero. half-even: ties to the even neighbour. up: away from zero. down: toward zero. ceiling: toward +infinity. floor: toward -infinity.

name: cash-rounding
